talkingPoints.text: separated lashes, no smudging or wearing off

benefits.text: BBIA Never Die Mascara Slim is a mascara with an ultra-slim brush that helps coat each lash precisely, creating a naturally curled, evenly separated effect. It holds the curl for a long time, does not smudge or wear off, and layers easily multiple times without clumping thanks to its light, smooth Neat Coating formula. The slim 5mm brush design is easy to control and suits even lower lashes or hard-to-reach lashes.

howToUse.text:
Brush lashes from root to tip in a zigzag motion to separate them evenly. 
Can be repeated several times to reach the desired thickness without worrying about clumping. 
Suitable for both upper and lower lashes.

safety.text:
For external use on the eye area only; avoid direct contact of the product with the eyes.
If it gets into the eyes, rinse thoroughly with water immediately and stop use if any unusual signs appear.
